# Third-party images in the user guide

| File | Author and source | Licence | Changes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `pico-pinout-r0.3-circuitstate.png` | Vishnu Mohanan, CIRCUITSTATE Electronics: "Raspberry Pi Pico pinout diagram", revision R0.3 (2022-12-06), from https://www.circuitstate.com/pinouts/raspberry-pi-pico-rp2040-microcontroller-board-pinout-diagrams/ | Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International (CC BY-SA 4.0, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/); the page also states CC BY 4.0 | none, copied unchanged |

The author notes that the pinout is based on Raspberry Pi's documentation and that its correctness cannot be guaranteed: check pin functions against the official
[Pico pinout](https://datasheets.raspberrypi.com/pico/Pico-R3-A4-Pinout.pdf) and [RP2040 datasheet](https://datasheets.raspberrypi.com/rp2040/rp2040-datasheet.pdf).
These images keep their own licence; they are not covered by the licence of the repository's code.
